name: Drapery
desc: A heavy cloth hanging in deep folds with no outline anywhere — the whole form is carved out by a single raking light that drifts across the catenary ridges, sinking the valleys to near-black while the crests catch and the weave tooth breaks up every surface.

relief.doc: fold depth — flat sheet to dramatic canyon folds

scale.doc: fold width and spread across the frame

speed.doc: how fast the light rakes and the cloth settles

x.doc: drape centre / light falloff anchor x

style.doc: chiaroscuro: heavy velvet, one warm raking source, near-black valleys · marble: the drape read as carved stone, cool, wrapped subsurface light · silk: high anisotropic sheen streaking along each fold · contour: the fold height field as bright iso-lines on a dark ground — pure topographic abstraction

act.doc: hang: settled and still · gather: the drape slowly gathers and releases over ~5 minutes · breathe: the whole cloth billows on the swell

seed.doc: deterministic seed — same number, same piece
